2) Shared implementation timeline and responsibilities (we'll draft by Feb 20)
3) Schema validation run against a small sample prompt set

Can you confirm who from IntegrateCo will attend the workshop and whether Aaron from AcmeTech (your third-party integrator) should be included?

Cheers,
